inputs.text: pixel art sprite, game asset, 32-bit pixel art. A huge, heavy cave bear boss in three quarter view facing left, walking low on all fours. Its near foreleg has grown into a giant steel grappling claw, twice as long and thick as its other legs, made of dark gunmetal steel segments, its three huge hooked steel fingers folded under it like a gorilla's knuckles so it walks on them; its shoulders sit high, its back slopes down to low hips, and the heavy claw side sags lower. Its ribs and breastbone have pushed out through the fur of its chest as a cage of curved dark steel bars, and deep inside the cage one small round heart glows turquoise; the bars themselves are dark steel, not glowing. A low ridge of dark steel grows from its brow back along the top of its skull like a bony crest, flush with the skull, not a crown or helmet. Shaggy warm brown fur, a massive shoulder hump, a huge heavy head with a scarred muzzle and small eyes; its other paws are ordinary bear paws with dark claws. Menacing, heavy and sad, real animal proportions, gritty detailed 32-bit arcade boss sprite. Clean dark outline, crisp shading with few colours. The whole body inside the image with clear margins. One creature only. Plain flat uniform blue grey (#56616c) background, no floor, no shadow, no text.
